request-prompt: Hide all maintenance and administrative links on the page, specifically the metadata actions row ('view', 'talk', 'edit', 'history', 'watch') under each daily article and the 'Edit' tab at the top of the page.
goal: I prefer to passively consume curated content as-is and avoid engaging in any collaborative editing or backend processes.
jobs: I want to browse a calendar of high-quality, curated articles for May 2026 to discover interesting topics to read.
I want to verify the schedule and blurbs of featured articles for May 2026 to ensure there are no errors before they appear on the Main Page.
I want to easily edit a specific day's featured article summary to improve its formatting or correct inaccuracies.
I want to sign up to receive the daily featured article by email to read them on a regular basis without visiting the site daily.
I want to explore past featured articles from other months or years through the archive links.
I want to check the selection criteria, guidelines, and upcoming requests for Today's Featured Article to understand how content is chosen and how I can participate.
